description: R76: the charge-sensitive fit with the isovector exchange's own transfer slope (the R75 contract, b_isovector free)

judgment.f_central: 0.05 by judgment (R74, R75: 0, compatible with zero)
judgment.f_isovector: 0.35 by judgment (R75 with the shared slope: 0.181)
judgment.b_isovector: 8.0 GeV^-2 by judgment (peripheral pion and rho/a2 exchange; B_SD 3.04 at R75)

texts.parametrization_space: epsilon_nd, logit w_excited, log flavor weights, f_isovector, log b_isovector, f_central
texts.report_title: R76: the charge-sensitive fit with the isovector transfer slope
texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines; the isovector exchange fraction and its own transfer slope free; diffractive shapes free.
texts.obligation: the central-component test and the isovector test with the isovector exchange's own transfer slope (R76)
texts.hypothesis: R75 found the isovector exchange required at f_isovector = 0.18 with the vacuum's transfer slope; the forward protons (an I = 3/2 line decays to a leading proton with the transfer's p_T) limit the fraction, and the fit lowered the diffractive epsilon to supply the forward pi-, at the cost of soft central pions. The pion and rho/a2 exchanges are peripheral: R76 frees their own transfer slope.

kernel_change.diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the forward isospin probe, the isospin completion by sector, the isovector exchange class)
kernel_change.isospin_completion: baryonic Q = -1, 0, +2; strange baryonic Q = +-1; strange mesonic K- and K+ like (decay daughters)
kernel_change.delta_lines: the I = 3/2 root families at Q = +1 and 0 (the isovector exchange's Delta-like lines)
kernel_change.isovector_exchange: I = 1 exchange, I3 transfer t = -1, 0, +1 with the Clebsch-Gordan line states (P(t) = 1/3, equal reduced couplings), drawn per SD, DD and ND event; its own transfer slope b_isovector (free); the mass laws shared with the vacuum exchange
kernel_change.unchanged: the continuation law (density with the P-wave barrier), the channel weights, the source density, the catalog vertices, the flavor ledger, the central mass law

texts.shapes_note: the class fractions stay at the external anchors (diffraction is the owner's global-fit question); the diffractive epsilon and B_SD are free

texts.reading: the isospin of the exchange adjacent to each leading line (the end link of the multiperipheral chain), not the reggeon share of the total cross section
